name: 3D-BRPIF-Benchmark
description: Initial Release (v1.0.0) This release provides the instances, computational results, and solution files for the Three-Dimensional Block Relocation Problem with Item Families (3D-BRPIF). The repository includes four datasets: 3D-BRPIF-Benchmark_dataset/: Newly generated benchmark instances, computational results, and solutions. Boge&Knust_dataset/: Instances and results for the BRPIF proposed by Boge and Knust (2023). FeatureAnalysis_dataset/: The 50 instances used for feature analysis. Lee&Lee_dataset/: Instances and results for the BRP proposed by Lee and Lee (2010). The computational results cover the applicable methodologies, including Greedy Heuristic (GH), Tabu Search (TS), Integer Linear Programming (ILP), and Reinforcement Learning (RL). See README.md for the complete repository description, dataset organization, references, and licensing information.
